spec.description: VisionReferenceImageSpec defines the desired state of VisionReferenceImage

boundingPolys.description:
Optional. Bounding polygons around the areas of interest in the reference
 image. If this field is empty, the system will try to detect regions of
 interest. At most 10 bounding polygons will be used.

 The provided shape is converted into a non-rotated rectangle. Once
 converted, the small edge of the rectangle must be greater than or equal
 to 300 pixels. The aspect ratio must be 1:4 or less (i.e. 1:3 is ok; 1:5
 is not).

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The VisionReferenceImage name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

uri.description:
Required. The Google Cloud Storage URI of the reference image.

 The URI must start with `gs://`.
